art_direction: Original late-1990s military support aircraft; dark grounded aerospace forms with restrained identification accents.
animation: Four held perceptual frames per craft for engine compression and navigation-light cadence.
layering: Aircraft bodies are authored sprites; tanker hose, drogue, progress UI, gunship fire and target effects remain independent animated gameplay layers.
provenance: Original EVAVO military art. Hammer, Spectre and Atlas v3 are authored directly at native resolution through hash-recorded deterministic pixel/cel builders; Spectre and Atlas include registered directional bank silhouettes. Rapier v3 is a reference-bound provider-assisted repaint, mastered through EVAVO Art Studio and reduced through its hash-recorded deterministic builder. Retained earlier source families remain available.
